data_access_comparison.measure: Presence of the requested snapshot values or no-record result in the answer, not overall answer accuracy.
data_access_comparison.limits: Both arms had the same dictionary and paired questions, but the no-tool arm lacked the underlying records and had different access instructions. This compares access plus tooling, not MCP against equally informed SQL or files. Questions were repository-visible.

numerical_payload_review.result: The checked payloads agreed with the applicable references, which were independently recomputed from the pinned public NOAA CSV archive.
numerical_payload_review.limits: Payload counts include repeats and do not establish final-answer correctness or scientific validity.

answer_review.method: Partial AI-assisted analyst review, not independent scientific review.
